title: 第21章 贾老板和小魏
content_zh:
第21章 贾老板和小魏-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

上一章

存书签

下一章

2008年，乐视网正处于关键转折期，囤积版权是他们的战略之一。

老贾很看好影视剧版权的升值空间，他现在买一部电影才花几万块，还能分销给其他视频网站。

就像魏沐刚才说的，躺着赚钱。

这小子年纪轻轻就能看出来其中布局，只这一份眼光就够让老贾当一回伯乐。

“怎么样？有没有兴趣来互联网，不比你演戏强？”

面对娱乐圈，这群互联网老板有着天生的优越感。

不怪他们这么想，现在拍一部戏能赚几个钱？

几十万还是几百万？

他乐视今年至少融资5000万！！

不是一个量级的圈子。

现在还不是未来，没有日收一爽那么夸张，明星更不是资本，这群做互联网的当然看不起娱乐圈。

娱乐圈在他们眼里只是消遣的玩具，就像老贾的老婆甘薇。

别看两人结婚，但老贾怎么可能只有她一个女人。

而且，他们两人的婚姻势必会有婚前协议....

见对方还在犹豫，老贾再次邀请:“期权，股票，我给你的条件不会差，比演员赚的多，怎么样？”

“感谢贾老板认可，但我还是更想在这个圈子讨食。”

“唉，你小子。”

贾老板有些失望，他没想到对方会拒绝。

魏沐当然心动，但他有自知之明。

吹牛逼谁不会？他能和老贾吹到明天。

但是，他根本没有做互联网的经验，他对娱乐圈更了解。

贸然去一个新环境，只会暴露自己的真实水平。

“好了，你不愿意我不会强求，今天遇到乐视粉丝，我很高兴，咱们喝几个。”

说着话，老贾挥手叫来了服务生，点了几瓶人头马XO。

这些酒都不便宜，他给其他女人分了一瓶，然后给魏沐倒上。

本来以为今天会在无聊等待中度过，没想到还有个人聊天解闷。

而且魏沐的一些观点让他耳目一新。

魏沐作为酒场老手，早就养成了见人说人话，见鬼说鬼话的技能，三言两语两人便开始称兄道弟。

Chapter 21 Boss Jia and Xiao Wei - "China Entertainment 2008: Starting from a Happy Breakup"

In 2008, LeTV was in a critical turning point, and hoarding copyrights was one of their strategies.

Lao Jia is very optimistic about the appreciation space of film and television drama copyrights. He now only spends tens of thousands of yuan to buy a movie, and he can also distribute it to other video websites.

Just like Wei Mu said just now, make money while lying down.

This kid can see the layout at a young age, and this insight alone is enough to make Lao Jia a bole.

"How about it? Are you interested in joining the Internet? Isn't it better than your acting?"

Facing the entertainment industry, this group of Internet bosses have a natural sense of superiority.

No wonder they think so. How much money can you make from filming a movie now?

Hundreds of thousands or millions?

He LeTV will raise at least 50 million this year!!

It's not a circle of magnitude.

Now is not the future, it is not as exaggerated as a daily income, and celebrities are not capital. Of course, these Internet people look down on the entertainment industry.

In their eyes, the entertainment industry is just a toy for entertainment, just like Lao Jia's wife Gan Wei.

Regardless of the two getting married, how could Lao Jia only have her as her only woman.

Moreover, their marriage is bound to have a prenuptial agreement...

Seeing that the other party was still hesitating, Lao Jia invited again: "Options, stocks, the conditions I will give you will not be bad, you can earn more than an actor, how about it?"

"Thanks to Boss Jia for the recognition, but I still want to beg for food in this circle."

"Oh, you kid."

Boss Jia was a little disappointed. He didn't expect the other party to refuse.

Of course Wei Mu was moved, but he was self-aware.

Who can't brag?He can play with Lao Jia until tomorrow.

However, he has no experience in the Internet at all. He knows more about the entertainment industry.

Rushing to a new environment will only expose your true level.

"Okay, I won't force you if you don't want to. I'm very happy to meet LeTV fans today. Let's have a few drinks."

As he spoke, Lao Jia waved to the waiter and ordered a few bottles of Remy Martin XO.

These wines are not cheap. He gave a bottle to the other women and poured it for Wei Mu.

I thought I would spend today in bored waiting, but I didn't expect that I would have someone to chat with to relieve my boredom.

Moreover, some of Wei Mu's views were refreshing to him.

As a veteran of the wine shop, Wei Mu has long developed the skill of talking to people and ghosts, and the two of them began to call each other brothers after just a few words.
